_schema.description: Skill definitions read by SkillDatabase. Kusakam's skills (D141, D148); learn with skill points (D149), upgrade to rank 20 (D150). Effects D207. Numbers are mock.

entry.name: String
entry.class_id: String - matches pathfinder_classes.json; empty means any class
entry.jp_cost: int >= 0 - Job Points spent to unlock
entry.sp_cost: int >= 0 - active only, forced to 0 for passive
entry.cooldown: float >= 0 seconds - active only, forced to 0 for passive
entry.vfx: res:// .tscn of the cast effect (SkillCastFX: 'charge' during the wind-up, 'release' on completion) - active only (D271)
entry.heal: int >= 0 - HP restored on the target (D142: an ally next to the hero, else the hero)
entry.damage: int >= 0 - damage to everything in front of the hero (D142)
entry.required_weapons: [equipment slot] - usable only while one of these slots holds a weapon (D141)
entry.burn: {dps: int, duration: float} - sets the target burning (D207); a new burn refreshes
entry.chain: {radius: px, ratio: 0..1} - also hits the nearest other enemy within radius of the first target (D207)
entry.stun: float seconds - stuns the first target; cancels a wind-up in progress (D207)
entry.cast: {windup: s, release: s, pose: Player.tscn animation prefix (<pose>Windup / <pose>Release)} - active only, required; a stagger during the wind-up interrupts (D259, D271)

skills.name: Healing Palm
skills.description: Restores 40 HP to an ally next to you, or to yourself. Learned from level 2.

skills.name: Fire Strike
skills.description: A burning strike at everything in front of you; sets them burning. Needs a sword or a dagger in hand.

skills.name: Electric Strike
skills.description: A crackling strike at everything in front of you; jumps to one more enemy nearby and stuns the first. Needs a halberd or a mace in hand.

skills.name: Shield Block
skills.description: Take 20% less damage while a shield is equipped.
